placement.status: Dish offset chosen to reconcile current provisional hub and damper without moving existing parts. This is not evidence of production fit. Existing pump staging datums and its block interface remain unresolved.
placement.belt_alignment_limit: Tensioner station was revised from X465 to X473.56 to align its illustrative center with the pump and damper groove mean. Its 37.5 mm overall width gives 8.75 mm nominal margin on each side of an assumed 20 mm centered belt. This is a modeling reconciliation, not measured production alignment. Actual belt tracking, usable pulley face width, wrap and vehicle datums remain unresolved.
